name: 48362 · Lake Orion, MI
findings: ZIP 48362 (Lake Orion) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48362 (Lake Orion) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48362 (Lake Orion) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
